platform_sub: The fully costed platform of the 2026 leadership campaign: thirteen policy areas and more than 190 commitments, reconciled to the provincial budget baseline.
note: This section keeps the campaign's own design so the platform reads as it did at the time. The campaign concluded on September 30, 2026.

chapters.title: A Hopeful Future For Young Ontarians
chapters.tagline: Give young Ontarians a real shot at the life their parents had: a serious education, a stable family, and a home of their own, in the province where they grew up.

chapters.title: No Seniors Left Behind
chapters.tagline: Make Ontario the best place in Canada to grow old: at home as long as possible, with care close by, and a real long-term care space when it's needed.

chapters.title: An Opportunity Economy
chapters.tagline: Restore Ontario's place as Canada's growth engine: simpler taxes, faster permits, fewer subsidies, and a real comparative advantage in the industries that will drive the next economy.

chapters.title: Restore Faith That Democracy Can Deliver
chapters.tagline: Make Ontario's democracy worth defending: representative institutions, transparent decisions, and a public service that actually delivers.

chapters.title: Build Homes, Build Communities, Build Futures
chapters.tagline: Build more homes, build them better, and build them beautifully. End the speculation that put homeownership out of reach for a generation.

chapters.title: Healthcare You Can Depend On
chapters.tagline: Healthcare that's there when you need it: a family doctor, an ER that doesn't take twelve hours, and the doctor-training capacity to keep up with the people who live here.

chapters.title: Get Serious About Education
chapters.tagline: Get serious about education: properly funded classrooms, restored standards, and a postsecondary system aligned to the future economy.

chapters.title: Clean Energy For A Prosperous Future
chapters.tagline: Make Ontario the cheap-power capital of North America. Electricity abundance is how Ontario industrializes and decarbonizes at the same time.

chapters.title: Northern and Rural Communities Deserve Better
chapters.tagline: Ontario’s future depends on Northern and rural communities with reliable services, safer roads, growing main streets, and world-class food and resource economies.

chapters.title: Build The Future Of Transportation
chapters.tagline: Ontario pays too much and builds too little. Deliver transit continuously, connect regions by rail, and get roads moving again.

chapters.title: A Welfare System That Lifts People Up
chapters.tagline: Rebuild welfare as a path back to stability, build the treatment and crisis system Ontario has been missing, and protect housing stability for the Ontarians closest to the edge.

chapters.title: Real Justice and Orderly Immigration
chapters.tagline: Restore the rule of law, defend communities from hate and intimidation, and restore faith in Ontario's immigration advantage.

chapters.title: Reform Dividends
chapters.tagline: The savings and revenue Ontario captures when its government builds, taxes, and works competently.
